title: Prefix delegation on bare-metal nodes: a later rollback below v1.11 is disruptive and unsupported

detection.reason: ENABLE_PREFIX_DELEGATION's VALUE is not collected (env names only) and whether a node is bare metal is decided by its instance type

quote: If you're using Prefix Delegation feature on Bare Metal instances, downgrading to an earlier version of VPC CNI from v1.11+ will be disruptive and not supported.
remediation: Treat crossing v1.11 as one-way on clusters that run prefix delegation on *.metal nodes: plan the rollback path as 'drain and replace the metal nodes', not 'reapply the old manifest'. Changing ENABLE_PREFIX_DELEGATION itself also needs kubelet max-pods updated (kubelet restart or node recycle).
verifyCommand: kubectl -n kube-system get ds aws-node -o json | jq -r '.spec.template.spec.containers[] | select(.name == "aws-node") | .env[]? | select(.name == "ENABLE_PREFIX_DELEGATION") | "ENABLE_PREFIX_DELEGATION=\(.value)"'  # =true together with nodes whose label node.kubernetes.io/instance-type ends in .metal means a rollback below v1.11 is unsupported
